lamar.title: Kajal Lamar Eau de Parfum
lamar.tagline: Liquid gold — mesmerising, fascinating, and utterly enticing.
lamar.story_intro: Lamar is the fragrance that put Kajal on the global map. Created by the legendary Mark Buxton in 2020, Lamar takes its name from the French word "Lumière" meaning light, and is known as liquid gold, mesmerising, fascinating, and utterly enticing. It is, without question, the most talked-about and sought-after fragrance in the Kajal portfolio.
story_full: The opening is lush and tropical. Fruity notes, bergamot, coriander, cardamom, and orange create a sun-drenched, golden introduction that feels warm and inviting from the very first spray. There is an immediate sense of luxury and generosity that sets Lamar apart from more restrained compositions.

The heart is where the magic happens. Bulgarian rose oil, Turkish rose, marigold, magnolia, jasmine, and saffron come together in a rich, multi-layered floral bouquet that is both opulent and addictive. The dual rose combination creates a depth that single-rose fragrances simply cannot match, while saffron adds a golden, spiced warmth that ties everything together.

The base provides a warm, lasting foundation of ambroxan, cedarwood, vanilla, cashmere wood, and musk. Longevity sits at eight to ten hours with heavy sillage. A word of caution: one spray is usually sufficient. Lamar projects with serious intensity, and over-application can be overwhelming.

Lamar works across all seasons and suits everything from social events to date nights to casual weekend wear. This is the crowd-pleaser, the compliment-getter, and the gateway into the world of Kajal. Available exclusively in Australia at Khrisha Perfumery.
faqs: Wear time varies with skin, weather and application. Trying a sample is the best way to discover its performance on you.
Start with a light application and consider the people and space around you. A sample helps you judge its projection.

discovery.title: Custom Discovery Set
discovery.tagline: Your next favourite fragrance starts here.
discovery.description: Six niche fragrances, chosen your way. Pick the scents you’re curious about, or let us create a selection around the notes and styles you love.
faqs: Your Custom Discovery Set contains six 3ml perfume samples. The fragrances are personalised to your choices or curated around your preferences.
Can I choose all six fragrances?
Yes. Choose “I’ll choose my six” and pick each fragrance above. Your choices are saved with your order.
What if I’m not sure what to choose?
Choose “Curate for me” and share the notes, brands or scent styles you enjoy. Our boutique will build a selection tailored to your taste.
Does the set always contain the same fragrances?
No. This is a custom discovery set, rather than a fixed selection. The fragrances depend on your choices and the preferences you share.
